title: Syphilis was called the 'French disease' after an outbreak in:

body.stem: Syphilis was called the 'French disease' after an outbreak in:
body.explanation: Caused by Treponema pallidum, treated with penicillin.

title: Vitalism holds that life is explained by:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Vitalism holds that life is explained by:
options: Peculiar life forces linked to the soul or spirit
Physical and chemical forces only, studied by experiment
body.explanation: Mechanism (materialism) explains life by physics and chemistry.

title: Pulmonary circulation was first described by:

body.stem: Pulmonary circulation was first described by:
body.explanation: His work was unknown in Europe until translated; Servetus later described it and was burned in 1553.

title: Autopsies for retrospective diagnosis began around the:

body.stem: Autopsies for retrospective diagnosis began around the:

title: Leprosy is the main historical example of:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Leprosy is the main historical example of:
options: A disease cured by quarantine and a successful vaccine
Social prejudice and excessive isolation for a mildly contagious disease
body.explanation: Leprosaria and bells.

title: 'Similia similibus curantur' (like cures like) is the ancestor of:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: 'Similia similibus curantur' (like cures like) is the ancestor of:
body.explanation: Contraria contrariis curantur = opposite cures opposite.

title: Societies typically react to epidemics first with:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Societies typically react to epidemics first with:
options: New prevention policies and immediate control measures
body.explanation: Then panic and flight, explanations, control measures and finally return to normal life.

title: John Snow linked cholera to drinking water in:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: John Snow linked cholera to drinking water in:
body.explanation: Vibrio cholerae was identified in 1884.

title: The plague is caused by:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: The plague is caused by:
options: Yersinia pestis, carried by fleas of the black rat
body.explanation: Confirmed by DNA sequencing of old remains.

title: In the 15th century, mercury was used to treat:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: In the 15th century, mercury was used to treat:
body.explanation: The age of metals, influenced by alchemy.

title: Michael Servetus was burned alive in 1553 for:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Michael Servetus was burned alive in 1553 for:
options: His theological views (his book also described pulmonary circulation)
Describing the circulation of blood against Galen's teaching
body.explanation: His description of pulmonary circulation appeared in a theological work.

title: Galen's physiology lasted until the 15th-16th centuries mainly because:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Galen's physiology lasted until the 15th-16th centuries mainly because:
options: Dissection and experiment confirmed it at every step
It suited the Church and was repeated without expressed doubt
body.explanation: Life force = soul fitted religious doctrine.

title: Teleology is:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Teleology is:
body.explanation: It is opposed to empiricism (observation).

title: 'Physiology' comes from Greek and means:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: 'Physiology' comes from Greek and means:
options: The study of the body's structure
body.explanation: Pathology = study of suffering; pharmacology from pharmakon (drug, remedy, poison).

title: Health as a balance of the four humours belongs to:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Health as a balance of the four humours belongs to:
options: The faith and divine will model
body.explanation: The three ways of explaining illness often coexisted.

title: The five functions of pathology include all of the following EXCEPT:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: The five functions of pathology include all of the following EXCEPT:
body.explanation: The fifth function is to justify treatment and prove or refute an explanation.

title: Mithridate and theriac were:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Mithridate and theriac were:
body.explanation: Theriac kept a mystical aura until the 19th century.

title: 'Primum non nocere' means:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: 'Primum non nocere' means:
body.explanation: The first principle of pharmacology.

title: Galenical pharmacology trusted mainly:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Galenical pharmacology trusted mainly:
body.explanation: About 300 medications plus diet, bloodletting, baths and exercise.

title: Ontological theories of disease see disease as:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Ontological theories of disease see disease as:
options: What the patient has (an outside entity)
A humoral imbalance inside the patient (what the patient is)
body.explanation: Physiological theories focus on the inside: what the patient is.

title: The first large wave of the Black Death reached Europe in:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: The first large wave of the Black Death reached Europe in:
body.explanation: It killed about 30% of Europe.

title: The difference between illness and disease is that:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: The difference between illness and disease is that:
options: Illness is the patient's suffering (constant), disease is the medical idea about it (changes with knowledge)
Disease is always visible, while illness is only mental and does not change with time
body.explanation: Illness is patient-centred.

title: Galen believed that blood:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: Galen believed that blood:
options: Was made in the bone marrow
Was formed in the liver and passed through invisible pores in the heart's septum
Circulated in a closed loop, pumped by the heart through arteries and veins
Was pumped only by the lungs
body.explanation: Human dissection was forbidden, so he relied on animals.

title: According to the course, the main point of studying the history of medicine is to:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: According to the course, the main point of studying the history of medicine is to:
options: Understand how medicine became what it is, with intellectual humility
Prove that ancient medicine was always wrong
body.explanation: Knowledge is produced inside a culture and stays open to revision.

title: In ancient physiology, the 'natural spirit' was:
subject: subj:history

body.stem: In ancient physiology, the 'natural spirit' was:
options: The source of motion in the brain
Blood imbued with air in the lungs
Blood made from food in the liver
body.explanation: Vital spirit: blood with air in the lungs; animal spirit: motion, in the brain.
